blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **внима́тельный** — attentive, observant, observing, mindful, watchful. Wiktionary: внима́ть + -тельный.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отврати́тельный — disgusting (repulsive, distasteful); значи́тельный — considerable, sizeable, strong, substantial, large; внима́тельный — attentive, observant, observing, mindful, watchful; продолжи́тельный — long.
**очарова́тельный** — charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating. Wiktionary: очарова́ть + -тельный.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: очарова́тельный — charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating; исключи́тельный — exceptional; насме́шливый — mocking, derisive, sarcastic; созна́тельный — conscious, conscientious.
